long_name: Example lake temperature model (GEFS air temperature regression)
description: At each lake, a linear regression of daily mean water temperature on daily mean 2 m air temperature from the NOAA GEFS analysis, fitted to the past year. It is driven by the 31 members of the NOAA GEFS ensemble weather forecast (both read from dynamical.org), each member's air temperature passed through the regression plus a draw from its residuals, to give a 31-member ensemble forecast of water temperature. A deliberately simple model that shows the ensemble submission format and how to read weather forecasts from dynamical.org.

answers.has_parameters: Yes and at least one is estimated from data
